# Confirm selected recovery windows expire drafts on time

## What & Why
The current regression coverage checks the selected duration shown in both notices and checks expiry at the default duration. A focused test should also prove that a non-default preference controls the actual deadline, so users do not see a longer countdown but lose the draft early.

## Done looks like
- A browser test selects a non-default recovery window.
- Answer and opportunity drafts remain recoverable until that selected deadline.
- Both drafts expire and announce their loss after the matching deadline.
